dataAuthorization.title: Data authorization
dataAuthorization.boundary: Choose data and recipients, an approval mode and read validity, then confirm. Authorization administrators may handle grants directly; delegating handling does not grant reading.
dataAuthorization.snapshotOnly: Select a table or schema/node to list existing ordinary tables (up to 200), then remove any table. Views and future tables are excluded. Outcomes are shown per table.
dataAuthorization.catalogUnavailable: Business approval requires an available Catalog and entry-read permission. New business approval cannot currently be configured; existing business approval is never downgraded.
dataAuthorization.initializeRequired: First authorization also requires approval initialization permission. Changing an existing mode requires a separate administrator permission.
dataAuthorization.changeBoundary: Only the approval mode for future authorizations changes. Existing grant scopes, expiry and revocations remain unchanged. This action grants no data read access.
dataAuthorization.changeConfirm: Change “{target}” to “{mode}”. Existing grants remain intact; future authorizations use the new mode. This action grants no read access.
dataAuthorization.changed: Approval mode changed; existing grants remain unchanged. You can now handle read authorizations under the new mode.
dataAuthorization.successorRequired: Changing to direct approval also requires your account's Grant creation permission to take over future handling. This does not grant you data read access.
dataAuthorization.versionConflict: Another operation changed this approval mode. Your reason is preserved. Refresh and review it before explicitly confirming again; no automatic retry is performed.
dataAuthorization.businessBoundary: Business approval needs confirmation by the Catalog business owner. This only configures the mode, without granting read access; continue in Catalog filtered by engine and table name.
dataAuthorization.selectionFailed: A complete table list could not be obtained or exceeds 200 tables. No tables were added. Narrow the selection or retry.
dataAuthorization.initialize: Configure approval mode for the first time
dataAuthorization.tableOnly: Browse ordinary tables directly without scanning or cataloging. Only the selected table is configured, not views, the entire database or future tables.
dataAuthorization.readRequired: Reading configuration requires approval-mode read permission and management qualification (administrator or delegated handler).
dataAuthorization.browseRequired: Selecting tables requires engine catalog read permission. Contact your permission administrator.
dataAuthorization.unsupported: The engine cannot be browsed or its ID cannot be safely represented. Confirm that the engine is active and online.
dataAuthorization.exists: This table already uses {mode}. Initial configuration cannot override an existing arrangement.
dataAuthorization.invalid: Select an ordinary table, explicitly choose an approval mode and enter a configuration reason.
dataAuthorization.confirmBody: Configure {target} to use {mode}. This only sets the approval mode; it does not grant data reading to any account.
dataAuthorization.saved: Approval mode saved. No data reading permission has been granted.
dataAuthorization.failed: No reliable result was obtained. Refresh to check; this page never automatically retries or claims configuration took effect.

descriptions.independent: Approved by a person with independent approval permission and effective engine management delegation. Catalog deployment or cataloging is not required.
descriptions.catalog: New grants require a valid sharing confirmation from the current Catalog business owner. A Catalog outage never automatically switches to independent approval.

delegations.readRequired: Reading delegations and their history requires separate delegation read permission.

delegations.invalid: Select an active account, enter a reason and a future expiry not exceeding its tenant membership expiry.
delegations.failed: No reliable outcome was obtained. Your draft is retained. Refresh to check; no automatic retry is performed.

source_data_authorizer.description: Configures table approval modes, issues independent read grants, reads history, and revokes grants within an active engine management delegation; selects users, departments, or project groups without automatically gaining data read or delegation management access.

engine_access_delegation_administrator.name: Engine Authorization Administrator
engine_access_delegation_administrator.description: Handles direct approval or delegates authorization within the current tenant, without self-delegation. This role grants no data read access and does not replace business approval.

infrastructure_administrator.name: Tenant Infrastructure Administrator
infrastructure_administrator.description: Manages engines, applications, API keys, and resource reclaim, and reads health status.

monitoring_operator.name: Monitoring Operator
monitoring_operator.description: Manages alert rules, incidents, and notification destinations, and reads execution and health status.

meta_runtime.name: Metadata Scan Runtime
meta_runtime.description: Reads tenant engine connections for metadata scans and writes tenant audit events.

orchestrator_runtime.name: Task Orchestration Runtime
orchestrator_runtime.description: Calls task providers and resolves execution authorization subjects without independent data permissions.

portal_runtime.name: Asset Portal Aggregation Runtime
portal_runtime.description: Reads tenant service endpoint projections only after user asset authorization is confirmed, without independent asset access.

service_publisher.name: Service Publisher
service_publisher.description: Reads data and the Meta catalog, and manages service definitions and external registrations.
